title: AI jitters meet a jobs report and falling oil prices: What to watch this week
title_zh: 人工智能的紧​​张情绪与就业报告和油价下跌相结合：本周值得关注的内容
summary: After a roller-coaster week in the markets, thanks to flip-flopping sentiment about AI spending, investors will get plenty more action on the calendar as we enter jobs week.
summary_zh: 在市场经历了过山车般的一周之后，由于对人工智能支出的情绪反复无常，随着我们进入就业周，投资者将在日历上采取更多行动。

title: Google limits Meta’s use of its Gemini AI models, FT reports
title_zh: 据英国《金融时报》报道，谷歌限制 Meta 使用其 Gemini AI 模型
summary: June 28 (Reuters) - Google has put limits on Meta’s use of its Gemini AI models after the social media company sought more computing capacity than the rival tech group could provide, the Financial
summary_zh: 6 月 28 日（路透社）——在社交媒体公司寻求比竞争对手科技集团所能提供的更多计算能力后，谷歌对 Meta 使用其 Gemini AI 模型设置了限制。

title: Crypto's brutal week in review: Bitcoin prices, illicit Iranian transactions, & more
title_zh: 加密货币残酷的一周回顾：比特币价格、伊朗非法交易等
summary: Scott Melker reviews the week crypto just had, including bitcoin (BTC-USD) prices plummeting, Bitmine (BMNR) joining the Russell 1000 (^RUI), and more. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto.
summary_zh: Scott Melker 回顾了加密货币刚刚过去的一周，包括比特币 (BTC-USD) 价格暴跌、Bitmine (BMNR) 加入 Russell 1000 (^RUI) 等。 《The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker》每天中午 12:00 播出...

title: As oil fades as an inflation concern, will AI take its place? The Fed is watching closely.
title_zh: 随着石油不再成为通胀问题，人工智能会取代它吗？美联储正在密切关注。
summary: Oil prices are tumbling now that the Strait of Hormuz is open, potentially averting a continued rise that could have led to broader, more persistent inflation. But as energy prices plunge, the Federal Reserve may have a new inflation hurdle: artificial intelligence.
summary_zh: 由于霍尔木兹海峡开放，油价正在暴跌，这可能会避免持续上涨，从而导致更广泛、更持久的通胀。但随着能源价格暴跌，美联储可能面临新的通胀障碍：人工智能。

title: This is not what a risk-off month usually looks like: Chart of the Day
title_zh: 这不是避险月份通常的样子：每日图表
summary: Many of the market's biggest winners this month are hiding in places investors were not watching a month ago.
summary_zh: 本月市场的许多最大赢家都躲在投资者一个月前没有关注的地方。

title: SpaceX rises modestly ahead of Russell rebalance, Nasdaq entry next
title_zh: SpaceX 在罗素调整之前小幅上涨，接下来将进入纳斯达克
summary: By Noel Randewich June 26 (Reuters) - Shares of SpaceX rose a marginal 0.15% on Friday ahead of its inclusion in Russell indexes, with passively managed funds tracking those benchmarks required to add
summary_zh: 作者：诺埃尔·兰德维奇 (Noel Randewich) 6 月 26 日（路透社）——周五，SpaceX 的股价在被纳入罗素指数之前小幅上涨 0.15%，被动管理基金跟踪了纳入罗素指数所需的基准。

title: SpaceX set to join Nasdaq 100, paving way for wave of passive buying
title_zh: SpaceX将加入纳斯达克100指数，为被动购买浪潮铺平道路
summary: SpaceX will be added to the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 index on July 7, exchange operator Nasdaq confirmed on Friday, ‌paving the way for a surge in passive investments in Elon ‌Musk's rocket and AI giant. To make it more attractive for companies seeking U.S.
summary_zh: 交易所运营商纳斯达克周五证实，SpaceX 将于 7 月 7 日被纳入以科技股为主的纳斯达克 100 指数，这为埃隆·马斯克的火箭和人工智能巨头被动投资激增铺平了道路。使其对寻求美国的公司更具吸引力
